reviewMethod: Read all 38 current full-case packets and mapped the exact headword-bearing turn rather than trusting the record owner.
Retested every prior REVISE finding and performed a whole-entry actor, prose, lexical-boundary, sense, and #0g regression review.
Checked all six current entry hashes against the source ledger; the source composite independently reports 38/38 exact zc verification.
Edited, promoted, merged, and published nothing.
summaryFinding: Two repairs are clean. Four entries still contain exact-actor regressions revealed by full-case reading: a section owner replaced by an unrelated master, explicit named verse/formal-address voices left anonymous or called compiler narration, and monk questions assigned to the responding record owner.

findings: The original o2 defect is resolved: the uncued poem after the stove-spirit narrative is no longer transferred to Pizao Duo.

Whole-entry regression o4: 國師歎曰 explicitly introduces the headword-bearing poem; the actor is Nanyang Huizhong, not compiler narration. He is already present in ContextMasters but with the wrong person-described role.

Whole-entry regression o6: 因齋時聞鼓聲 is narrative setup before 師云, so Yunmen Wenyan does not utter the headword. MasterName must be null and the narrative actor recorded without assigning Yunmen backward.
The explanation remains supported after those actor corrections.
The malformed and overclaiming explanation is cleanly replaced by bounded English-first prose.

Actor regression o1: the enclosing heading is 湖州福源石屋清珙禪師 and the passage narrates his residence at 福源 before his uninterrupted 入院，上堂. The utterer is Shiwu Qinggong, not Yuezhou Qianfeng; the current note's claim of a nearby Qianfeng speech cue is contradicted by the full case and heading.
Occurrences 2-6 and the one-sense formula treatment hold.

o1 correctly stops transferring the preceding monk across the verse boundary, but it remains under-attributed. The work is 天目中峰廣錄 and the immediate section heading is 自讚: this is Zhongfeng Mingben's self-eulogy, so a master voice is nameable rather than an unnamed individual poem author.
Occurrences 2-7, the body-as-skin-bag sense, and the revised explanation hold.
Prior o3 is now correctly an unnamed individual verse author rather than a generic compiler; the verse has no cue identifying its individual author.
Prior o5 is now correctly assigned to Jingfu, whose first-person preface and dated signature name him.
Narrated, lay-patron, and lexical-title uses all hold; the explanation distinguishes lineage standing from an ordinary artisan without outside interpretation.
Prior o1 and o2 respondent reversals are resolved: both headwords occur in unnamed monks' questions.
o4 and o6 correctly retain Shushan Kuangren because each stored cut begins with Shushan's own stated formula before Yunmen's later questions; they are not backward respondent assignments.
All six cases support the interview-question field described by the explanation.
Prior o3 is resolved: the unnamed monk asks the comparison and Lingyin Xuanben is not assigned backward.

Whole-entry regression o4: 問 begins the anonymous interlocutor's comparison through 離此二途未審洞山如何為人; Zhimen Guangzuo's 師曰 answer follows it. The headword is therefore uttered by the unnamed questioner, not Zhimen.
Whole-entry regression o5: the full unit explicitly begins 天童樸禪師，上堂, and the headword is in that uninterrupted address. It is Tiantong Pu's utterance, not compiler narration.
The Linji/Deshan paired-formula explanation otherwise holds.
